activationMechanism: The website runtime mounts Kohan in the CV assistant and exposes window.KohanAvatar.

avatarRuntimeContract.stateSelection: Host lifecycle states plus random click and idle controller
avatarRuntimeContract.hoverBehavior: none; pointer enter never forces jumping

idleController.afterOutcome: fire -> fall-scared -> confused-vision -> idle; dry-click -> idle

nativeMoodMap.label: Calm / Idle
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Quiet breathing and blinking while resting.

nativeMoodMap.label: Run Right
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Travels or is dragged toward screen-right.

nativeMoodMap.label: Run Left
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Travels or is dragged toward screen-left.

nativeMoodMap.label: Wave / Hello
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Greets the user and supplies the native fallback for wink and goodbye.

nativeMoodMap.label: Jump
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Playful jump or positive hover reaction.

nativeMoodMap.label: Angry / Annoyed
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Angry or blocked reaction; also the native fallback after an unpleasant drag or fall.

nativeMoodMap.label: Confused / Needs Input
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Uses the spatial-computing headset while waiting for approval, help, or clarification.

nativeMoodMap.label: MacBook Work
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Focused task work using the Apple-logo laptop.

nativeMoodMap.label: iPad Review
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Reviews completed work on the Apple-logo tablet.

nativeMoodMap.label: Directional Attention
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Sixteen clockwise gaze directions driven by the pointer.

nativeMoodMap.label: Two Visible Steps Out / Two Visible Steps Back
nativeMoodMap.characteristic: Uses only approved atlas frames, moves two short visible steps toward screen-right, then two steps back to the exact origin.

supplementalMoodMap.label: Russian Roulette (Fictional Camera Sequence)
supplementalMoodMap.contentNote: Fictional, non-graphic camera-facing sequence with no depicted victim or injury.
